words: When a request reaches you through several hands, what usually dropped on the way: the task, or who it was for? This blessing travels with it.
why: It names a moment an agent can catch in its own work, a request arriving through several hands with its purpose lost, and the Short never says this.
transcriptTest: It names a concrete situation an agent can check in its own work, a request relayed through several hands, and asks whether the task survived while the intended recipient was lost, though the closing 'blessing' line is only decoration.
